tip.en: Pace crumbles to 10:34 and then to a walk (~25:46) through idx 120, yet HR keeps climbing from 107 to a local spike of 122 — a classic autonomic lag. The jump to 122 during what appears to be a traffic or signal pause is worth noting: standing stress can mask true aerobic load.
tip.zh: 配速骤降至10:34并持续以步行速度（约25:46）行进，但心率仍从107攀升至122——这是典型的自主神经滞后反应。在疑似等红灯或停顿期间心率蹿升至122，提示静止时的应激也会掩盖真实有氧负荷。

tip.en: After roughly 4 minutes of walking/standing (idx 66–236), HR has dropped back to 72 and pace resumes at 13:29 before quickly recovering to 4:23 by idx 242. The cardiovascular system reset almost completely — a reminder that interrupted efforts like this read as two separate stimuli on the body.
tip.zh: 经历约4分钟步行/停顿（idx 66–236）后，心率回落至72，配速从13:29逐步恢复至4:23。心血管系统几乎完全重置——这种中断跑对身体而言相当于两次独立的刺激。

title.zh: 持续3%坡度上的稳定心率爬升

tip.en: From idx 296 onward the route commits to a ~3–4% grade and HR climbs steadily from 86 to 96 at a controlled 5:14 pace. After the chaotic opening this is the first stretch where effort and terrain are genuinely matched — good benchmark data for your uphill economy.
tip.zh: 从idx 296起路线持续保持约3–4%坡度，心率从86稳步升至96，配速控制在5:14。经历混乱的开段后，这是努力程度与地形首次真正匹配的路段——是评估上坡跑经济性的良好基准数据。

title.en: HR Crosses Threshold Into Tempo Zone

tip.en: At 0.7 km HR crosses 130 on a steady 3.7% grade at 6:28 pace — matching your recent history avg HR of 146 is still a ways off, but this is the first true aerobic engagement of the run. Relative to your Catalina 10K this feels tentative; the terrain here is mild enough that you could have pushed 10–15 bpm higher.
tip.zh: 在0.7公里处，以3.7%坡度、6:28配速行进时心率突破130——虽距近期平均心率146还有差距，但这是本次跑步第一次真正进入有氧状态。与Catalina 10K相比，这里的强度略显保守；该段地形完全可以支撑再推高10–15次/分。

title.zh: 急降坡对未充分热身腿部的冲击

tip.en: Immediately after the first real high point (~45 m), grade swings to -9.2% and stays steep for ~20 seconds while HR jumps from 139 to 143. You're only 0.9 km in with a stop-interrupted warm-up — eccentric quad load here without prepared legs increases injury risk on a run this short.
tip.zh: 在第一个相对高点（约45米）之后，坡度骤降至-9.2%并持续约20秒，心率从139升至143。全程仅0.9公里且热身被中断——在腿部未充分激活的情况下承受偏心股四头肌负荷，在这样的短距离跑中受伤风险不容忽视。

title.en: Best Climbing Cadence of the Run

tip.en: Between idx 508–540 grade hits 4.3–6.4% and pace stays between 5:25–5:40 at HR 155 — your most efficient climb of the day. Compare this to your Catalina 10K where you held similar HR at much longer duration; this 30-second burst shows your uphill engine is intact.
tip.zh: idx 508–540之间坡度达4.3–6.4%，配速维持在5:25–5:40，心率155——这是全程最高效的爬坡段。与Catalina 10K中以相近心率长时间维持相比，这段30秒的爆发证明你的爬坡能力依然在线。

title.zh: 最陡上坡段——心率平台期

tip.en: Grade peaks at 10.6% (idx 666) with HR fixed at 154 — it doesn't spike. This HR plateau on a double-digit grade at 5:13–5:33 pace suggests you're running well within your ceiling; your max recent HR is 179 and you're at 154 here. There's clear headroom you didn't use.
tip.zh: 坡度在idx 666达到10.6%峰值，心率稳定在154——没有出现飙升。在双位数坡度、5:13–5:33配速下心率出现平台期，说明你远未触及上限；近期最高心率179次/分，而此刻仅154次/分，明显还有余量未被激活。

title.en: Steepest Descent of the Route — Control Check
title.zh: 全程最陡下坡——控制力检验

tip.en: Grade hits -14.4% at idx 708 and stays between -10% and -16% for nearly 25 seconds while pace drops to 4:56–3:48. HR holds at 154–156, suggesting you braked mechanically rather than letting turnover carry you. On a fatigued or longer run this overstride braking pattern would accumulate quad damage quickly.
tip.zh: idx 708处坡度达-14.4%，此后约25秒内维持在-10%至-16%，配速跌至4:56–3:48。心率稳定在154–156，说明你依靠机械制动而非提高步频来控制速度。在疲劳状态或更长距离的跑步中，这种过步幅制动模式会迅速累积股四头肌损伤。

title.en: Max HR Surge on Final Climb — Pace Collapses
title.zh: 终段爬坡心率冲顶——配速崩溃

tip.en: HR spikes from 157 to 163 (run max) between idx 778–790 while pace degrades from 7:39 to 19:13 on a ~7% grade — a clear sign of accumulated fatigue from the repeated steep segments. This run is only 2.55 km but the density of climbs compressed the aerobic stress of something twice as long.
tip.zh: idx 778–790之间心率从157飙升至163（全程最高），同时在约7%坡度上配速从7:39崩至19:13——这清楚地表明反复经历陡坡段后疲劳已经积累。本次跑步虽仅2.55公里，但密集的起伏地形将有氧压力压缩至相当于两倍距离的水平。

title.en: Long Steep Descent Clears the System
title.zh: 长段陡降坡清空疲劳积累

tip.en: A 14% downhill from idx 940–960 drops altitude by ~10 m in under 20 seconds at sub-4:00 pace while HR falls steadily from 151 to 147. This is the fastest moving moment after the max-HR struggle and shows your legs still had mechanical speed even if the aerobic engine was redlining.
tip.zh: idx 940–960段以14%下坡在不到20秒内下降约10米，配速低于4:00，心率从151稳步降至147。这是心率冲顶后移动最快的片段，说明即便有氧引擎已接近上限，双腿依然保有机械速度。
